subject: MAP: Staging bridge & auth orchestration for POC
messages:
From: Liam Cole <liam@clearbridge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — staging bridge + auth details needed for POC

Rishi / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We want to lock the MAP items for the evaluation so our security and infra teams can provision on their side. Primary asks for the POC environment:

- API key provisioning (service account vs long-lived key)
- Org setup / team invites (who needs what role)
- IP allowlist entries (CIDR ranges we will provide)
- VPC peering options (shared VPC or peered VPC)

Can you share the specific steps we should include in our internal runbook? Goal is to have staging wired and smoke-tested within two weeks.

Also: who should our infra lead (listed below) contact for the peering config?

Liam Cole
ClearBridge Health — Technical Program Manager
liam@clearbridge.com

---
Liam added: eng-team@clearbridge.com to keep infra looped.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Liam Cole <liam@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — staging bridge + auth details needed for POC

Thanks Liam — good summary. High level plan below; I'll drop a technical checklist in a follow-up from Karthik.

Top-level MAP items for staging bridge:
1) API keys: we recommend creating a short-lived service account key for the POC with scoped read/write tokens. We'll provision a pre-created service account and provide a script to mint keys via our console. For now, plan for: one service account for integration + one long-lived API key for manual debugging.

2) Org setup: add at least two users from ClearBridge as "Project Admins" (can invite by email). We'll send the exact invite flow and required roles.

3) IP allowlist: share the public egress ranges you plan to use. We'll add them to staging network and open ports 443 & 8443 for control plane and metrics.

4) VPC peering: preferred is peered VPC with route advertisement. We support both peering and a VPN overlay; peering is lower maintenance but requires route table edits on both sides.

Karthik will follow up with the exact commands, Terraform snippets, and a small sample of the network config. Monica will coordinate mutual action plan doc and timeline.

Deliverables: MAP spreadsheet (skeleton), network snippet, pre-provisioned service-account name, and a proposed close timeline. Expect those items by EOD 2027-05-06.

Next step: can your infra lead share the public egress CIDRs and the preferred peering contact?

— Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam Cole <liam@clearbridge.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — staging bridge + auth details needed for POC

Liam / team —

Attaching a couple of items (see attachments): CB_MAP_v2.xlsx — a filled MAP skeleton showing owners and due dates; network_config_snippets.txt — example allowlist + peering snippets.

Quick technical checklist (staging):
- Service account: create rwood-poc-int-sa@clearbridge with IAM role: "redwood-integration-runner" (least privilege). We will send a console link to bind that role.
- API keys: after SA creation, run our one-line helper to mint an ephemeral key (valid 24h) for CI and generate a long-lived token for manual debug stored in your secrets manager.
- Org invites: invite user emails as "Project Admin" & "Viewer" roles per MAP sheet. Admins: liam@clearbridge.com, infra-lead@clearbridge.com.
- IP allowlist (basic): add these egress CIDRs to your firewall: 54.174.0.0/16, 3.210.0.0/16. Open outbound ports 443, 8443.
- VPC peering: we support peering with route table entries both ways. Sample AWS CLI snippet in network_config_snippets.txt: create-peering-connection, accept-peering, modify-route-table. You'll need to add our staging CIDR 10.40.32.0/20 to your routing.

Notes:
- If you need to use a shared VPC, we can create a transit gateway connection (longer lead time).
- For strict compliance customers, we can also do a restricted ingress proxy (adds ~2 days).

I'll be available for a 30-min pair-config slot; tell me which times next week.

Attachments (referenced): CB_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP workbook), network_config_snippets.txt (AWS CLI + Terraform snippets).

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Liam Cole <liam@clearbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, eng-team@clearbridge.com
Date: 2027-05-10T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — staging bridge + auth details needed for POC

Thanks Karthik — this is actionable. A couple of clarifications from our infra side:

- We will create the service account as requested (rwood-poc-int-sa@clearbridge) and will use SecretsManager to store the long-lived key.
- Our egress ranges are slightly different — primary ranges: 34.201.0.0/16, 52.86.0.0/16. Can you confirm these are acceptable?
- Peering contact: infra-lead@clearbridge.com (CC'd). They prefer peering (no transit gateway).

Timeline request: Can we target a staging cutover + smoke test by 2027-05-17? That gives our SOC team time for a quick review. If peering is straightforward, we can hit that date.

Also, one ask — will you require any account-level DLP policy exceptions to allow token exchange traffic?

Liam

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam Cole <liam@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, eng-team@clearbridge.com
Date: 2027-05-12T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — staging bridge + auth details needed for POC

Liam —

Confirmed on our side: the ranges 34.201.0.0/16 and 52.86.0.0/16 are fine; we'll add them to the staging allowlist. No DLP exceptions required from Redwood for token exchange (we use short-lived tokens by default).

I've updated the MAP doc (link below) with owners and a suggested sprint plan. Proposed milestones:
- 2027-05-11: Service account created & invites sent (your side)
- 2027-05-13: Peering request accepted and route tables updated (both sides)
- 2027-05-16: Smoke test (integration + latency check)
- 2027-05-17: Sign-off (POC close for staging)

Can we schedule a short pairing session on 2027-05-13 10:00 PT to walk infra through the Terraform snippet? Karthik will lead.

MAP doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAPClearBridge

— Monica
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Liam Cole <liam@clearbridge.com>, infra-lead@clearbridge.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — staging bridge + auth details needed for POC

Team —

Thanks everyone — this is locked in. Final checklist for cutover:
- Confirm service account created and that SecretsManager entry is accessible to your CI.
- Confirm peering accepted + both route tables include: 10.40.32.0/20 <-> your staging CIDR.
- We will push a smoke test job that mints an ephemeral key and runs a 5-minute run of the typical workload.
- If smoke passes, we will mark the MAP milestone as complete and open the formal evaluation window.

Attachments here include the MAP workbook and the network snippets for your infra team to apply. If anything blocks the 05/17 target, escalate to me directly at +1 (415) 555-0199.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: CB_MAP_v2.xlsx, network_config_snippets.txt
